about_the_game:
Zombies Attack is a retro pixel action game. Pick up your weapons and fight your way through the terrifying zombies! !

Features:

– Take you back to the nostalgic retro pixel style of the 1990s.

– Pick up your weapons, slash, rush, jump, and an exciting adventure is waiting for you!

– A variety of weapons, such as knives, chainsaws, hammers, various guns, throwing objects, fire bottles, etc., defeat various BOSSes and perfectly avoid their attacks

– The music is also in retro 8-bit style! !
